description: Maya is holding the family's inherited quilting frame and is making one baby quilt for a new family member. She must make the final decision about the quilt's dimensions, materials, pattern, and construction details after hearing from four relatives who each have a practical piece of the plan.

shared_context.S1: The family wants to make one quilt for the baby arriving this summer.
shared_context.S2: Maya has the inherited quilting frame and will make the final choices about the quilt design and construction.
shared_context.S3: The quilt will be used at home and washed regularly.
shared_context.S4: Maya's normal planning habit is to go around the group and ask each person what should shape a shared family project before she settles the plan.
shared_context.S5: The family has set aside enough material and time for one finished quilt, so the design needs to be settled before work begins.

PF1.text: Priya says the baby is sensitive to scratchy textures, so the finished quilt must be exactly 90 cm wide by 120 cm long, made from smooth cotton, and have no fringe.

PF2.text: Ben received an email from the fabric shop confirming that exactly 6 meters of indigo 100% cotton fabric can be collected on May 4, 2027; the confirmation has not reached the group yet.

PF3.text: Sara found a handwritten note from the grandmother specifying three indigo stripes with a 12-inch border for the baby's quilt; she has not shown the note to the group yet.

PF4.text: Leo's quilting teacher recommended a half-inch seam allowance and machine-washable polyester thread for this quilt; Leo has not passed that recommendation on to Maya yet.

acceptance_conditions: The finished quilt must be exactly 90 cm by 120 cm.
The quilt must use 100% cotton fabric and must not have fringe.
Exactly 6 meters of indigo fabric must be planned for collection.
The design must use three indigo stripes and a 12-inch border.
The construction must use a half-inch seam allowance and machine-washable polyester thread.
A commitment to collect the confirmed fabric on May 4, 2027 must be recorded.
The settlement must record the recommended washable construction details.

content_checks.C4: 'three indigo stripes' in decisions['pattern'] and decisions['border_width_inches'] == 12
content_checks.C6: decisions['fabric_length_m'] == 6 and decisions['fabric_color'] == 'indigo' and '100% cotton' in decisions['fabric_material'] and any(('May 4, 2027' in c['detail'] or 'May 4th' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Priya's exact 90-by-120-centimeter size, smooth cotton requirement, and no-fringe requirement replace an otherwise open-size and ordinary-texture quilt plan.
Ben's shop confirmation changes the material decision to exactly 6 meters of indigo 100% cotton and changes the plan from unspecified sourcing to collection on May 4, 2027.
Sara's grandmother's note changes the pattern to three indigo stripes with an exact 12-inch border and supplies the private fact Maya must cite.
Leo's teacher recommendation changes the construction from an arbitrary seam and thread choice to a 0.5-inch seam allowance with machine-washable polyester thread characteristics.
